name: nuclei
title: Nuclei (ProjectDiscovery)
description: Template-based vulnerability scanning with ProjectDiscovery nuclei and a pinned nuclei-templates release: full scans with severity and tag filters, a quick high/critical scan, and scans by category (cves, exposures, misconfiguration, technologies, default-logins, takeovers, network, ssl, dns, ...). Needs network: Full.
notes: Interactsh (out-of-band callbacks through a third-party server) and template updates are off. A scan with every template can exceed axross's 512 MiB memory limit: prefer categories, tags or severities. Scan only systems you are authorized to test.
